metadata.title: Midjourney, Part Three.
metadata.audience: HAI Lyrical Literacy volunteers who have completed Parts 1 and 2. Internal training, not promotion.
metadata.narration_notes: Host is Rohan V. Full name spoken EXACTLY ONCE, in BOUT. Phonetic spellings deliberate for Kokoro G2P: 'Rohaan' = Row-Haan. Do NOT 'correct' them. SPINE: the opened-image action rail in the product's row order, from MIDJOURNEY-UI-SPEC.md section 3, built by reading three captures first-hand. The 'Help us improve V8' row is OMITTED from every mockup - VIDEO-PIPELINE.md section 7 forbids a version number on screen. Pan/Zoom/Remix are named but NOT depicted in use: there is no capture of them, and section 8 forbids depicting an uncaptured surface. No pricing. No series count. Every MjL3* scene passes kicker='LYRICAL LITERACY · MIDJOURNEY TUTORIAL PART 3'. Heteronym pass: 'a separate section' -> 'another section'; 'Use carries' -> 'The Use row carries'. B07 added 2026-09-07 from 'options.png': the list icon's 9-item menu. Counts are DERIVED from MJ_OPTIONS in MjL3Options.tsx, never typed. Copy/Report submenu contents are NOT captured and must not be shown. Download Image is a single action - do NOT give it a format submenu by analogy with Suno.

beats.narration_text: Hi, I'm Rohaan from Humanitarians AI. This is Part 3. You have a prompt that works and four images back. Now open one of them. There is a panel beside it that does most of the useful work in Midjourney, and it has six labelled rows.

props.command: I like one of the four. What can I do with it?
output: Six rows under Creation Actions - what each pair of buttons does.
The checklist that hides three more actions from you.
And turning a still into a clip.

beats.narration_text: Click any image and it opens with a panel down the right. Six labelled rows under the heading Creation Actions: Vary, Upscale, More, HD, Use and Edit. Below them, another section for turning the still into video. Every row is a different answer to the same question. You like this one, now what?

show.event: The opened view lands: image, panel, siblings

props.title: The panel beside one image
props.closing: Six rows, and every one of them starts another job.

beats.narration_text: The top two rows are pairs. Vary gives you a new set of four built from this image: Subtle nudges it, Strong takes a bigger step. Upscale adds pixels instead: Subtle keeps the detail honest, Creative invents some to fill the gaps. Vary changes what the picture is. Upscale changes how big it is.

show.event: Panel lands; Vary and Upscale hold, other rows desaturate

props.title: Vary, then Upscale
props.sparkLine: One changes the picture. One changes the size.

beats.act: Act 3 — Rerun and Run batch as HD
beats.narration_text: Rerun sends the same prompt again from scratch. Four fresh results, not variations of the one you are looking at. Run batch as HD re-runs the whole set at higher quality rather than just this image. Both of them spend another job, so it is worth knowing which one you meant.

show.event: Panel lands; More and HD hold

props.title: Starting over, and starting bigger
props.sparkLine: Fresh set, or the same set at higher quality.

beats.narration_text: The Use row carries something forward. Style takes the look of this image into your next prompt. Prompt drops the words back into the bar so you can change them. Edit has two doors: Quick Edit stays in this panel, and Open Editor is the full canvas, which gets its own part later.

show.event: Panel lands; Use and Edit hold

props.title: Carrying it forward, or changing it
props.sparkLine: Take the look, or take the words.

beats.act: Act 5 — More Options is a visibility checklist
beats.narration_text: There is a More Options link at the top of the panel. It is not a menu of actions. It is a checklist of which rows the panel shows you. Seven entries, and three of them arrive switched off: Pan, Zoom and Remix. They exist. They are simply not on screen until you turn them on.

show.event: Ticks appear on the four that are on
The three unchecked entries are named

props.title: Three actions you cannot see yet

beats.narration_text: Below the six rows sits Animate Image. Open it and you get two more rows. Auto lets Midjourney decide what moves. Loop builds a clip that runs back into itself. Each one offers Low Motion or High Motion. And once it is a video, the panel is shorter: no Vary, no Upscale, no Edit.

show.event: The panel lands with Animate Image expanded

props.title: Turning a still into a clip
props.sparkLine: Two rows. Then a shorter panel.

beats.narration_text: One more menu, and it is a different kind. The list icon at the top of the panel opens nine items. Two of them open a submenu. The other seven happen the moment you click. Download Image is the one you will reach for most, and it is a single action — no format to pick. More Options changed what the panel shows you. This one does something to the image.

show.event: The nine-item menu opens under the list icon
The two submenu carets light; the counts card resolves
Download Image lights as the hero row
The two-menus contrast and the callback card resolve

props.title: Doing something to the image
props.sparkLine: Nine items. Seven act at once.

beats.narration_text: To review. Open an image and the panel gives you six rows. Vary for a different picture, Upscale for a bigger one. Rerun for a fresh set. Use to carry the style or the words forward. Edit to change it. Animate to make it move. More Options shows the three rows that start hidden. And the list icon is where you download it.

props.artifactHeading: Six rows, and what each one starts
artifactLines: Vary - Subtle or Strong. A new set of four from this image.
Upscale - Subtle or Creative. More pixels, honestly or inventively.
More - Rerun. The same prompt from scratch, four fresh results.
HD - Run batch as HD. The whole set again, higher quality.
Use - Style or Prompt. Carry the look, or the words.
Edit - Quick Edit here, or Open Editor for the full canvas.
Animate Image - Auto or Loop, each Low or High Motion.
More Options - a checklist. Pan, Zoom and Remix start hidden.
The list icon - 9 items. Download Image is one click, no format step.

beats.narration_text: Part 4 is the settings panel, behind the sliders icon in the bar. Aspect ratio, the three dials, the model, and speed. It is where the chips beside your rows come from. Bring a prompt you like.

props.command: What do we cover in Midjourney Part 4?
output: The settings panel - four cards, opened by the sliders icon.
Aspect ratio, and the three Aesthetics dials.
Model, Raw, speed - and where your row chips come from.

show.event: Title and handle hold; ground opaque from frame 0
